title: Capability Grants and Natural Equipment
objective: Normalize species-granted abilities, actions/reactions, resources, resistances/immunities, proficiencies, natural weapons/armor/organs and other typed capabilities so every executable contribution has canonical identity/provenance and natural equipment resolves through shared item/ability/effect owners.
acceptance: every executable grant has canonical identity and provenance
natural equipment resolves through shared item/ability/effect contracts
boundaries: MVPS-06 owns species-facing general capability and natural-equipment grant integration only.
MVPS-05 physiology/lifecycle/environment-tolerance contracts remain authoritative and are consumed by reference.
Full equipment, vehicle, mount, implant and interface compatibility belongs to MVPS-07.
Lineage inheritance belongs to MVPS-08, form/transformation semantics to MVPS-09, and species progression/maturation to MVPS-10.
MVPS-07+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: No MVPS-06 work remains. MVPS-07 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority and requires a later owner Continue.

red.observed_failure: MVPS-06 regression alone failed because the capability-grant, natural-equipment, fixture and invariant artifacts did not exist; all prior OPS3/MVPS gates passed.

roadmap_reconciliation.rationale: MVPS has no hard/start gate or milestone rotation overriding strict order after MVPS-06.
